scenarioSurface.capabilityName: Construct a governed capability-author delegate request
scenarioSurface.scenarioName: Assemble the connector-ready delegate request deterministically

input.text: one bounded authoring profile with fixed feature identities, artifact slots, archetypes, provider policy, response schema, and evidence policy

event.text: the generic-connector model request is assembled as canonical JSON

outcome.text: one schema-valid Gemini delegate request with temperature zero, exactly one authorized attempt, no provider substitution, eleven named string slots, and explicit non-claims is returned without invoking the provider

scenarioSurface.notes:
A downstream consumer supplies one reviewed canonical capability feature and
  one bounded authoring-profile identity. The Agentic Harness derives the
  complete closed model-request authority needed to ask an admitted authoring
  model for exactly eleven projectable SDA candidate artifacts.

  The consumer does not hand-author a delegate JSON document. Capability,
  scenario, input, event, outcome, and contract identities come from the
  admitted feature. Artifact slots, filenames, admitted authority archetypes,
  transformation vocabulary, response non-claims, Gemini provider authority,
  temperature zero, one-attempt authority, no-substitution policy, and evidence
  capture policy come from the governed authoring profile.

  The resulting delegate request is both returned as an admitted carrier for
  the next harness operation and published beneath a fresh governed live-request
  destination derived from its unique run identity with its exact byte hash.
  Existing destinations are rejected; a concurrent request cannot replace an
  earlier request. Construction and publication do not call
  the model, accept candidate content, project an executable, or promote a
  capability. Repeating the same feature and profile produces byte-identical
  delegate request content apart from an explicitly supplied unique run ID.

userMessage.template: Decode the exact reviewed feature bytes below and author its complete eleven-artifact declarative SDA companion workspace. Reference: {featureReference}. Digest: {featureDigest}. Encoding: base64. Bytes: {featureBytes}. The feature annotations are the sole semantic-identity authority; copy every capability, root-scenario, scenario, input, input-contract, event, event-authority, outcome, outcome-contract, and terminal identity exactly. Never invent an undeclared scenario: rejection, timeout, malformed response, and other behavior partitions belong in fixtures unless separately declared as scenarios. Fill all eleven declared response slots with balanced JSON; summary placeholders are forbidden. Use the following admitted SDA archetypes exactly, with no summary aliases or alternative root keys: capabilityAuthority has capabilityId, name, mode equal feature or capability, userStory object actor/intent/outcome, experience object experienceId promised-experience.v1/actor/promise/observableConditions objects conditionId, and rootScenarioId. consumerWorkspaceAuthority has exactly workspaceType consumer-workspace-authority.v1, consumerId equal capability ID, kernel specificationId scenario-kernel.v1/version 1.0.0/executionVector ../../../scenario-driven-architecture/kernel/contracts/execution/scenario-kernel-execution-vector.json, governance authority ../../governance/no-hand-authored-code.policy.v1.json/conformancePolicy all-closures-must-conform, conformanceQuery ../../../scenario-driven-architecture/kernel/semantic-authority/consumer/scenario-conformance-closure.query-authority.json, telemetryAuthority ../../../scenario-driven-architecture/kernel/semantic-authority/consumer/scenario-execution.telemetry-authority.json, platformCapabilityCatalog ../../../scenario-driven-architecture/kernel/semantic-authority/consumer/sda-platform-capabilities.semantic-authority.json, projectionTargets [node,csharp,python], and capabilities as an array containing exactly one object with featureId/feature/capability/semanticGraph/executionAuthorities/projectionAuthorities/interfaces/fixtures file references. semanticGraphAuthority is root object transitions array; each transition has from and to objects scenarioId/outcomeContract or scenarioId/inputContract, semanticProgress monotonic, and bindingAuthorityId. executionAuthorities is exactly authorityType execution-authorities.v1 and executionAuthorities array; each declared scenario has one authority id equal event authority, owningScenarioId, operations containing only kind invoke-port portId, kind invoke-scenario scenarioId, or kind project-state projectionId. projectionAuthorities is exactly authorityType projection-authorities.v1 and projectionAuthorities array; exactly one record per declared transition with id, inputContract object contractId, outputContract object contractId, and kind projection or binding. interfacesAuthority has exactly interfaceAuthorityType consumer-interface-authority.v1, contractValidatorCapabilityId sda-schema-contract-admission.v1, contractCatalog contracts/contract-catalog.json, requiredPlatformObligations only admitted mechanic obligation names, interfaces as an array with one CLI object interfaceId/kind cli/rootScenarioId/platformCapabilityId sda-json-cli.v1, plus root arrays portBindings and projectionBindings. Never use cli singular, port singular, projection singular, authority, projections, partitions, or summary status substitutes. Pure carrier shaping uses sda-authority-transformation-port.v1 with transformationAuthorityRef semantic-transformation.authority.json and transformationId. External effects remain explicit port bindings, never transformations; bind an undeclared effect to its meaningful sda-* port capability ID with an authority reference and truthful held fixture testimony. projectionBindings use projectionId, platformCapabilityId sda-authority-state-projection.v1, configuration. semanticTransformationAuthority is exactly authorityType semantic-transformation-authority.v1 and transformations array of id/expression; object expressions use op object and fields, path expressions use op path/from/path, and only declared pure responsibilities receive transformations. fixturesAuthority is exactly fixtureType consumer-capability-fixtures.v1 and fixtures array; every fixture has fixtureId,input,portOutcomes object, optional projectionOutputs, and expected disposition/terminalScenarioId/scenarioSequence/outcomeAssertions. Include at least six complete deterministic partitions without adding scenarios. contractCatalog is an unwrapped root map: map every declared input contract identity to contracts/input.schema.json and every declared outcome contract identity to contracts/outcome.schema.json. The two fixed schema slots are carrier bundles, not two identities: inputContract and outcomeContract must each be closed JSON Schema 2020-12 documents with absolute https://schemas.agentic-harness.local IDs, $schema,$id,oneOf,$defs, and a separate $defs object for every mapped contract identity. Each oneOf must reference every $defs identity mapped to that schema; no catalog target may be an internal #/$defs reference, and no declared identity may be omitted, merged, renamed, or mapped to an unresolved definition. Use only literal,path,object,array,merge,map,flat-map,filter,find,some,every,includes,intersects,equals,length,greater-than,if,unique,join,format,escape-html,sha256,parse-json,let transformations. Emit no executable source and no admission, conformance, projection, promotion, replacement, deletion, or acceptance claim.
